02

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
fractionation

Remove one or ten percent per shell cycle without reducing shell precursor doses

Remove one or ten percent per shell cycle without reducing shell precursor doses. Withdraw 1% or 10% after each complete shell cycle but retain the original precursor doses. Both reduce precipitation; the larger withdrawal almost eliminates it but gives poor QY and misshapen particles. Lesser withdrawal gives rods or irregular particles. Missing fields: full per-layer accounting. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.

02
synthesis

Combine one-percent withdrawals with increased OA at the reported transition span

Combine one-percent withdrawals with increased OA at the reported transition span. Combine 1% withdrawals with 2.5-fold more OA per layer starting at the fifth to eighth shell. Thick-shell QY reaches 50% with symmetric spherical/hexagonal particles, while precipitation returns. Do not replace the experimental paragraph’s switch wording with a single exact cycle. Missing fields: exact switch cycle. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.

withdrawal
1 % · C1: Preferred main p.3 anneals S 1 h / Cd 2.5 h; Table 1 has separate S 1 h / Cd 3 h and other schedules.
